articles.title: Tassat wants to help smaller banks tap the trillion-dollar stablecoin boom before Wall Street lock them out
articles.snippet: The former Signet developer aims to launch early next year a marketplace connecting stablecoin issuers with regional lenders to manage reserves.

articles.title: Coinbase's corporate customers can now accept payments from AI agents
articles.snippet: Rolling out this week, Coinbase Business users will be able to accept payments from AI agents, done via the x402 protocol, developed and incubated by the exchange.

articles.title: Uniswap pushes deeper into tokenized assets with permissioned trading pools
articles.snippet: The framework, developed with Superstate, Securitize and Dowgo, lets regulated funds and securities trade on Uniswap while enforcing compliance rules necessary for institutions.

articles.title: Goldman Sachs CEO backs Clarity Act despite banking industry's concerns over stablecoin rules
articles.snippet: The Goldman Sachs CEO said the crypto market structure bill would create a more stable regulatory framework, breaking with other major bank leaders who oppose key stablecoin provisions.

articles.title: Bitcoin wilts as oil and rates rise. Clarity Act odds tumble to 38%
articles.snippet: Geopolitical risks, rising rates, and fresh regulatory setbacks send crypto lower as key Democrats demand stronger safeguards in the market structure bill.
